name: Smudge
tagline: Rewrites machine-sounding drafts so they read like a person
description: Hand it a draft with that obvious machine polish and it rewrites the phrasing until it reads like something a person typed. It does not hide its work: every tell it removed and every pattern it changed is listed, so you can review the edits and keep only the ones you agree with.
author: 9unsmoke
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
